title: Cayley-Hamilton / Hankel 2n-Sample Linear Recurrence Extrapolation Over F_p
claims: By the Cayley-Hamilton theorem, any matrix-power phase sequence z_k = <u, M^k s> mod p (M in F_p^{n x n}) satisfies an order-n linear recurrence over F_p.

Inverting the n x n Hankel matrix H_{i,j} = z_{i+j} mod p from the first 2n samples uniquely recovers the recurrence coefficients and deterministically predicts all future terms z_k (k >= 2n) with zero additional quantum queries.
favorable_controls: 3D general matrix over F_17 (6 training samples -> 14/14 exact out-of-sample predictions)
4D companion matrix over F_31 (8 training samples -> 16/16 exact out-of-sample predictions)
